cards.ex: She's a real go-getter; she'll achieve anything she sets her mind to.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy maqsadga intiluvchan; u o'zi maqsad qilgan har qanday narsaga erishadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadlariga erishish uchun qat'iyat bilan harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: That summer felt like a coming of age; I learned so much about myself.
cards.exUz: O'sha yoz ulg'ayish davridek tuyuldi; men o'zim haqimda juda ko'p narsalarni o'rgandim.
cards.uzDef: O'smirlik davridan kattalik davriga o'tish jarayoni.

cards.ex: I have a knack for remembering names; it's just something I'm good at.
cards.exUz: Menda ismlarni eslab qolish qobiliyati bor; bu shunchaki yaxshi qiladigan ishim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishda tabiiy qobiliyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, I'm passionate about helping people and solving problems.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, men odamlarga yordam berish va muammolarni hal qilishga ishtiyoqmandman.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa va aniq tarzda ifodalash.

cards.ex: My claim to fame is that I once won a national spelling bee.
cards.exUz: Mening mashhurlik sababim shundaki, men bir marta milliy imlo bellashuvida g'olib bo'lganman.
cards.uzDef: Shuhrat keltirgan narsa yoki yutuq.

cards.ex: We're always on the same wavelength, so working together is easy.
cards.exUz: Biz doimo bir xil fikrdamiz, shuning uchun birga ishlash oson.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlashda o'xshash bo'lish, bir xil tushunchaga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: My family has supported me through thick and thin.
cards.exUz: Oilam meni qiyin va oson kunlarda qo'llab-quvvatladi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday vaziyatda, qiyin yoki oson bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar.

cards.ex: I wear my heart on my sleeve, so people always know how I'm feeling.
cards.exUz: Men hissiyotlarimni yashirmayman, shuning uchun odamlar doimo qanday his qilayotganimni bilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Hissiyotlarini ochiqchasiga ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: I'm a bit of a jack-of-all-trades, so I can help with a lot of different things.
cards.exUz: Men hamma narsaga ozgina ustaman, shuning uchun men ko'p turli xil narsalarda yordam bera olaman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p narsalarni qila oladigan odam, lekin hech birida mutaxassis emas.

cards.ex: It took me a while to find my feet in the new job, but now I'm settled in.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda o'rnashib olish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi, lekin endi men joylashdim.
cards.uzDef: Yangi vaziyatga moslashish, o'zini qulay his qilish.

cards.ex: I used to be a people pleaser, but now I prioritize my own needs.
cards.exUz: Men ilgari xushomadgo'y edim, lekin endi o'z ehtiyojlarimni birinchi o'ringa qo'yaman.
cards.uzDef: Hamma odamlarga yoqishga harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: I get a kick out of helping others succeed; it's really rewarding.
cards.exUz: Men boshqalarning muvaffaqiyat qozonishiga yordam berishdan rohatlanaman; bu juda foydali.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir juda katta zavq olmoq.

cards.ex: I'd like you to meet my better half, Sarah.
cards.exUz: Sizni turmush o'rtog'im Sarah bilan tanishtirmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Turmush o'rtog'i, sherigi (odatda hazilomuz tarzda).

cards.ex: I'm always on the go, but I try to make time for my hobbies.
cards.exUz: Men doimo harakatdaman, lekin sevimli mashg'ulotlarimga vaqt ajratishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda harakatda bo'lish, band bo'lish.

cards.ex: I have a soft spot for animals, especially rescue dogs.
cards.exUz: Menda hayvonlarga, ayniqsa qutqarilgan itlarga nisbatan zaif joyim bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir yoki kimdirga nisbatan sevgi yoki zaiflik hissi.

cards.ex: I'm a teacher at heart, even though I work in administration now.
cards.exUz: Men qalban o'qituvchiman, garchi hozir ma'muriyatda ishlayotgan bo'lsam ham.
cards.uzDef: Aslida, chin dildan.

cards.ex: I try to step outside my comfort zone regularly to challenge myself.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimga qarshi turish uchun doimiy ravishda o'z qulaylik zonamdan chiqishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zini xavfsiz va qulay his qiladigan vaziyatlar to'plami.

cards.ex: I was a late bloomer academically, but I eventually caught up.
cards.exUz: Men akademik jihatdan kech ochilgan edim, lekin oxir-oqibat yetib oldim.
cards.uzDef: O'z tengdoshlaridan keyin iste'dod yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishgan odam.

cards.ex: I'm on the quiet side, but I enjoy spending time with close friends.
cards.exUz: Men bosiqroq tarafda bo'laman, lekin yaqin do'stlarim bilan vaqt o'tkazishdan zavqlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Odatda shovqinli va harakatchan bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I've always been a bit of a rolling stone, moving from place to place.
cards.exUz: Men doimo bir oz daydi bo'lganman, joydan joyga ko'chib yurganman.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyda uzoq turmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: I try to be a shoulder to cry on for my friends when they need it.
cards.exUz: Men do'stlarimga kerak bo'lganda dardkash do'st bo'lishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin paytlarda tasalli beradigan odam.

cards.ex: I was on cloud nine when I got the job offer!
cards.exUz: Men ish taklifini olganimda etti osmonda edim!
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand va baxtli bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'll bend over backwards to help my friends, even if it's inconvenient.
cards.exUz: Do'stlarimga yordam berish uchun jonimni berib ishlayman, garchi bu noqulay bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir uchun juda ko'p harakat qilish, ularga yordam berish uchun juda ko'p harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I put my heart into my work because I believe it makes a difference.
cards.exUz: Men ishimga mehr qo'yaman, chunki bu o'zgarish qiladi deb ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirga katta mehr va energiya sarflash.

cards.ex: She's a social butterfly, always flitting from one event to another.
cards.exUz: U ijtimoiy kapalak, doimo bir tadbirdan ikkinchisiga uchib yuradi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar bilan aloqa qilishni va ko'p vaqtni jamiyatda o'tkazishni yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: I stick to my guns when I believe I'm right, even if it's unpopular.
cards.exUz: Men to'g'ri ekanligimga ishonsam, hatto mashhur bo'lmasa ham, o'z fikrimda turaman.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrida qat'iy turish, boshqalarning fikriga qaramay.

cards.ex: I need to get my act together and start being more organized.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni qo'lga olishim va ko'proq tartibli bo'lishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tartibga solish, yaxshiroq ishlashni boshlash.

cards.ex: I don't want to be a yes-man; I want to offer my own perspective.
cards.exUz: Men "xo'p" deb turuvchi bo'lishni xohlamayman; men o'z nuqtai nazarimni taklif qilmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Har doim boshliqning fikriga qo'shiladigan odam, hatto o'z fikri boshqacha bo'lsa ham.

cards.ex: In my job, I wear many hats, from marketing to customer service.
cards.exUz: Mening ishimda men ko'p vazifalarni bajara olaman, marketingdan mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishgacha.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaqtning o'zida ko'p turli xil vazifalarni bajarish.

cards.ex: He's a diamond in the rough; he just needs some guidance.
cards.exUz: U xom olmos; unga biroz yo'l-yo'riq kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilanishi kerak bo'lgan, lekin katta salohiyatga ega bo'lgan odam yoki narsa.
